Cargo District Thursday

Wilmington, NC · Cargo District · Road

Beginner friendly

Cargo District Thursday is a road group ride in Wilmington, NC. It rolls every Thursday at 6:00 pm from Alcove Beer Garden. About 23–25 miles, d group 14–15 mph; C group 16–18 mph if a leader shows.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 14–15 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Cargo District Thursday group ride

A social club ride from the Cargo District. The main leader stays with the 14–15 mph group, so it suits people new to group riding. Park on the street; the lot is small. You sign the club waiver at the start.
